provider.name: IUCN Green Status of Species
provider.organization_type: global species-recovery assessment, conservation-impact, scenario, spatial-unit, evidence, standard, publication, and data infrastructure
provider.description: The IUCN Green Status of Species is a global framework for measuring how far a species is from full recovery, how conservation has changed its status, how dependent it is on continuing conservation, and how much recovery remains possible. It complements the IUCN Red List by assessing species recovery across spatial units, functional states, counterfactual and future scenarios, Green Scores, categories, conservation legacy, dependence, gain, and recovery potential.
